recognize_zh: BCL2 染色大致呈瀰漫性陽性（套層 B 細胞與 T 細胞皆陽性），只有結節內散在的淡染小區塊為陰性，對應被切碎的反應性生發中心，說明生發中心細胞不表現 BCL2，支持反應性的 PTGC 而非濾泡性淋巴瘤。
features: Diffuse BCL2 staining of small lymphocytes (mantle B cells and T cells) throughout the field
Multiple irregular, pale BCL2-negative islands within the large nodule corresponding to fragmented germinal centers
Rounded BCL2-weak/negative area at the lower left in a smaller follicle
No nodules with uniform strong BCL2 positivity of germinal center cells
Staining contrast is low at this magnification, limiting precise delineation
describe_en: BCL2 immunohistochemistry shows diffuse positivity in the small lymphocytes of the mantle zones and interfollicular T-cell areas, with multiple irregular pale islands within the enlarged nodule that are BCL2-negative and correspond to fragmented germinal center remnants. There is no evidence of follicles composed of BCL2-positive germinal center B cells, although the low contrast at this magnification limits fine assessment. Findings support a reactive process consistent with progressive transformation of germinal centers.

ddx.vs: Follicular lymphoma shows BCL2-positive germinal center (CD10+) B cells filling the follicles, whereas here the germinal center fragments are BCL2-negative (comparison with CD10 on a serial section confirms).
BCL2 does not separate these entities because both contain BCL2-positive small lymphocytes; the discriminator is the presence of LP cells, which are BCL2-negative.
